nodes.label:
New Item
Arrives
nodes.title: Club Inventory System
nodes.info: A unique physical identifier on every piece of equipment, a sticker or QR code linking that identifier to a record, and a shared log tracking every item's status.

nodes.label: Print Sticker
nodes.title: Inventory Sticker Printing
nodes.info: Printing a small durable sequentially numbered label -- from a sheet of adhesive labels or a dedicated label maker -- and applying it where it will survive handling.

nodes.label:
Generate
QR Code
nodes.title: QR Code on Kits
nodes.info: A small square barcode, printed alongside or instead of the numbered sticker, that a smartphone camera can scan to open that item's record directly.

nodes.label:
Log via Asset
Tagging Process
nodes.title: Asset Tagging Process
nodes.info: The one-time sequence that turns a brand-new item into a tracked one: assign the next unused sticker number, generate its matching QR code, and record both alongside the item's details.

nodes.label: Store on Shelf
nodes.title: Store on Shelf
nodes.info: The item sits in general circulation, available for the next checkout.

nodes.label:
Scan Out
(Checkout System)
nodes.title: Equipment Checkout System
nodes.info: Scanning an item's QR code, recording who has it and an expected return date, and updating its status. This generalises Chapter 21's kit loaner program to every tagged item.

nodes.label:
Returned by
Due Date?
nodes.title: Returned by Due Date?
nodes.info: The system compares today's date against the due date recorded at checkout.

nodes.label:
Scan In
(Return Tracking)
nodes.title: Equipment Return Tracking
nodes.info: Scanning a returned item's QR code flips its status back to 'in storage', time-stamps the return, and flags anything still checked out.

nodes.label: Flag as Overdue
nodes.title: Flag as Overdue
nodes.info: The mentor dashboard surfaces the overdue item automatically, prompting a follow-up before it becomes an audit surprise.

nodes.label: Semester Audit
nodes.title: Inventory Audit Process
nodes.info: A scheduled physical count of every tagged item against the inventory log -- typically once per semester -- confirming that every sticker number the log expects is actually present.

nodes.label:
Item Found
During Audit?
nodes.title: Item Found During Audit?
nodes.info: Every logged item not currently checked out should be physically present. Anything missing moves to the lost item policy.

nodes.label: Lost Item Policy
nodes.title: Lost Item Policy
nodes.info: A written no-blame procedure for a genuinely missing item: a fixed grace period to keep searching, and a clear point at which the item is written off and the log corrected.
